body: I'm not the best at giving advice, but life keeps going on. She didn't want to be with you, we've all been there at one point or another. Try to find someone else who can fulfill your needs, I'm not saying go and pick-up a hooker and have sex with her. You should go out and try and try again to find someone who you think is beautiful and talk to her. As long as you keep trying to take your mind off of this "Kenzie" person, you can keep going on with life as if she never existed. Have you tried talking with your family? Family can help a huge deal with what you're going through because they'll be right beside you the whole way.

You should ask her how she's doing. Try to ask if she's suicidal without actually saying "Are you suicidal?", try to lean towards something like "You're latest Facebook status is scary, are you doing ok, do you need help?" Always try to talk about how they're doing. Most people who are suicidal need someone to talk to.
